ledgerloop.example.subject: SOC 2 Type II before the next bank signs
ledgerloop.example.body:
Hi Priya,

Saw that LedgerLoop's bank customers now want a SOC 2 Type II report before they sign. That puts your audit timeline directly on the sales critical path.

The slow part of Type II is usually evidence: months of access reviews, screenshots and policy sign-offs across 150 people. Sprinto connects to your cloud, HR and code tools and collects that evidence continuously, so the observation window runs itself and your team reviews instead of chasing.

Worth a 15-minute look at how that would map to your current readiness plan?

Ravi

shipwise.example.subject: ISO 27001 for Shipwise's retail deals
shipwise.example.body:
Hi Meera,

Noticed that Shipwise's large retail customers are asking for ISO 27001 as part of procurement. At 45 people, that usually lands on the founder's desk with no one in-house who has done it before.

Sprinto gives you the policies, risk register and control monitoring ISO 27001 needs out of the box, and collects audit evidence from your existing tools, so you can get certified without hiring a compliance team or pulling engineers off the roadmap.

Would a 15-minute walkthrough be useful before your next procurement review?

Ravi

carepulse.example.subject: SOC 2 and HIPAA in the same year
carepulse.example.body:
Hi Anil,

Saw on your security page that CarePulse is preparing for its first SOC 2 audit and a HIPAA assessment this year, while hospital questionnaires keep coming in on every deal.

Most of that work overlaps. Sprinto maps one set of controls to both SOC 2 and HIPAA, collects evidence automatically from your cloud and code tools, and gives you a trust page to answer questionnaires, so your engineers are not pulled off the product twice.

Open to a 15-minute look at how teams your size run both together?

Ravi
